test_title: Most Repeated 2025 Current Affairs PYQ Subject Test - 01
subject: general
question: In January 2025, Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel inaugurated the Khel Mahakumbh in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. Which edition of the event was it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **January 2025**, the Chief Minister of **Gujarat**, **Bhupendra Patel**, inaugurated the **2nd edition** of the revamped sports event known as **Khel Mahakumbh 2.0**.
 
• The inauguration ceremony for this massive sporting initiative was organized in **Rajkot**, **Gujarat**, drawing thousands of spectators and athletes.
 
• The **2nd edition** of **Khel Mahakumbh 2.0** aims to further the state's vision of creating a robust sports culture by providing a platform for athletes from diverse backgrounds.
 
• During the event, Chief Minister **Bhupendra Patel** emphasized the importance of the "**Khelay Gujarat, Jeetay Gujarat**" motto, encouraging the youth to participate in sports for holistic development.
 
• The event focuses on identifying **grassroots talent** across various age groups, ranging from **under-9** to **senior citizens**, ensuring inclusivity in the sporting ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Origin of Khel Mahakumbh:**
 
 
• The initiative was first launched in the year **2010** by the then Chief Minister of **Gujarat** and the current Prime Minister of **India**, **Narendra Modi**.
 
• The primary objective was to celebrate the **Golden Jubilee** (50 years) of the state of **Gujarat** through sports.
 
 
 
• **Evolution to 2.0:**
 
 
• The transition to **Khel Mahakumbh 2.0** represents a modernized version of the tournament with better **infrastructure**, increased **funding**, and digital **registration** systems.
 
• The **1st edition** of the **2.0 series** was launched in **2023**, making the **January 2025** event the **2nd edition** under this new branding.
 
 
 
• **Participation and Scale:**
 
 
• The event has grown from **16 lakh** participants in its inaugural year to over **50 lakh** registrations in recent years.
 
• It covers more than **35 different sports**, including traditional Indian games like **Kabaddi** and **Kho-Kho**, as well as Olympic sports like **Archery**, **Athletics**, and **Fencing**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Prize Money and Incentives:**
 
 
• The **Government of Gujarat** has allocated a total prize pool exceeding **Rs. 40 crores** to reward winners at the **taluka**, **district**, and **state levels**.
 
• Successful athletes often receive additional support through schemes like the **Shaktidoot Scheme**, which provides financial assistance for training and nutrition.
 
 
 
• **Role of SAG:**
 
 
• The **Sports Authority of Gujarat (SAG)** is the nodal agency responsible for the seamless execution of the **Khel Mahakumbh** across the state.
 
• The **2025** edition in **Rajkot** highlighted the city's growing importance as a **sports hub** in the Saurashtra region.
 
 
 
• **Youth Empowerment:**
 
 
• The event serves as a feeder for national-level competitions like the **Khelo India Youth Games** and international events like the **Asian Games** and **Olympics**.
 
• By hosting the **2nd edition** in **January 2025**, the state government aims to keep the momentum high for the upcoming national sporting season.
